title: Smoky Skillet BLT
description: A twist on the classic BLT sandwich, adding smoky flavor to the hearty American favorite.
instructions: 1. Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Set aside.
2. Cook the bacon in the skillet over medium heat until crispy.
3. Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel.
4. Add butter to the skillet and let it melt.
5. Place the American cheese slices in the skillet and let them melt.
6. Pour the whisked eggs into the skillet and scramble them with the cheese.
7. Add the cooked bacon to the eggs and mix well.
9. Assemble the BLT by placing the egg mixture onto the toasted bread.
